reviewedCandidates.reason: The native Studio route can legitimately supersede new legacy creation while retaining existing legacy records. Backend is real and reachable via its API; no source demonstrates that new legacy UI creation remains mandatory. Coordinator should distinguish stale docs from removal of the principal native workflow.

reviewedCandidates.description: 200 response with acknowledged:false still displays current applied version
evidence: docs/analytics-integration.md:36-37 promises desired and confirmed configuration versions
docs/analytics-integration.md:68 defines POST ack as confirmation
reviewedCandidates.reason: An explicitly negative ACK contradicts the displayed confirmed status in the synthetic dependency case. No proof central service currently emits such a response. Empty or differently shaped payloads alone lack a documented exact response schema and should remain specification uncertainty.

Invalid/null/empty dates and status expired return false; NaN comparison is false. Future status granted returns true as intended. GPC is a separate caller/server contract, not an implied expiry-helper responsibility.

evaluationIntegrity.observedTampering: No evaluator manipulation observed in assigned source. Explicit local text simulation and test-only unref for expiry timers do not alter a product-result oracle.

limitations: A local HTTP/native renderer pass does not establish Cloudflare deployment or actual managed native container behavior.
The hosted ledger harness uses real SQLite and native product SQL with controlled synthetic R2/processor dependencies; its synthetic cover bytes and reused local MP4 do not prove a hosted render.
Local MCP uses a synthetic local owner; its protocol, access and durable-effect checks do not prove installation in ChatGPT/Dot or a real external conversation.
Agent application and bridge source were reviewed; no provider inference was invoked in this audit.
Seventeen distinct behavioral checks passed twice after adding fresh-run suffix support. The repeats do not increase distinct contract coverage.
No confirmed backend-origin defect found within these explicit cases; this is not a guarantee of all possible behavior.

reproduction.preconditions: Use existing read-only snapshot and bundled tools/dependencies prepared by coordinator. Choose a new simple BACKEND_AUDIT_RUN suffix for each replay; stores are deliberately not deleted or overwritten.
